supersedes.reason: the prior full-range recipe intersected reserved historical Test/Holdout intervals and the project registry rejected it before any training; this plan narrows the training interval and places diagnostics after that interval

training_interval.meaning: 2024-01-01 00:01 through 2024-07-16 00:00 UTC, half-open; ends at the earliest reserved Holdout boundary

training.all_fields_except_gamma: identical within every paired seed; initialized from the archived seed-102 PPO recipe

primary_diagnostic: paired per-seed net-return difference by post-training window and execution mode, compared with contemporaneous no-trade rollouts
advancement_gate: all three seed-mean paired deltas must be positive in both execution modes, and treatment seed-mean must exceed contemporaneous no-trade in at least two of three windows in each mode; passing only authorizes a separately preregistered five-seed confirmation
economic_scope: scenario-only Train development; no historical economic or independent OOS claim
